episodes.title: Precious Flowers
episodes.summary: In the halls of Aunt Lydia's premarital preparatory academy, the finest in Gilead, Agnes is assigned to mentor a new Pearl Girl and a fragile alliance begins.

episodes.title: Perfect Teeth
episodes.summary: As Agnes begins the rituals that mark her coming of age, she struggles with the confusing stirrings of adolescence. Meanwhile, Daisy is subjected to Gilead's system of discipline.

episodes.title: Daisy
episodes.summary: An incident on a school trip spurs Daisy's memories of Toronto, revealing her past and a world shattered by violence.

episodes.title: Green Tea
episodes.summary: As the Green girls gather for a tea party, Daisy struggles to keep on task, while Agnes begins to understand what being a woman in Gilead means.

episodes.title: Ball
episodes.summary: At a debutante-style ball where Green girls are paraded before Commanders, the illusion of elegance begins to fray. Agnes discovers Garth's status has changed.

episodes.title: Stadium
episodes.summary: As the Aunts sift through ancestry records to finalize matches, Agnes plots for her chance at love. Meanwhile, Lydia contemplates the choices that shaped her rise in Gilead.

episodes.title: Commitment
episodes.summary: As Daisy's secret past threatens to surface, Agnes grapples with an unwanted match and a forbidden crush. Becka meets with potential matches and finds unexpected kindness in one of them.

episodes.title: Broken
episodes.summary: As Agnes is swept up in wedding plans, Daisy hides a life-altering secret, and Hulda faces backlash after speaking out.

episodes.title: Marat Sade
episodes.summary: As Daisy steps into a new role, she considers what she's willing to lose to help her friends.

episodes.title: Secateurs
episodes.summary: While Becka faces the consequences of her actions, Agnes and Daisy must decide how far they're willing to go to protect her.
